definitions.gloss: to be so delicious one's cheeks could fall off
definitions.explanation: An exaggerated way to say that food tastes wonderful; used with feeling, often playfully or to children.

examples.japanese: ほっぺたが{落|お}ちそう！
ほっぺたが{落|お}ちるほどおいしかった。
⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦おはぎ→おはぎ：29365_ohagi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、ほっぺたが{落|お}ちるようなおいしさだ。
examples.english: The ohagi my grandmother makes are so good your cheeks could fall off.

notes:
Mostly in ほっぺたが{落|お}ちそう (an exclamation while eating) and ほっぺたが{落|お}ちるほどおいしい / ほっぺたが{落|お}ちるようなおいしさ. Casual and warm; not for formal reviews.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{頬|ほお}→頬：03717_hoo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: the same idiom with the standard word for cheek; a little more written
- ⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧ / ⟦うまい→うまい：01279_umai⟧: the plain words for tasty
